title: ARGYLE. COURT.
metaDescription: ARGYLE. COURT. — A 4.98-carat Fancy Very Pink oval, lab-grown to millimetre precision. By Bez Ambar, Los Angeles.
copy: A Fancy Very Pink oval, five carats, lab-grown to the millimetre — thirteen and a half millimetres end to end, nine across, five point eight deep. The pink saturates uniform through the length of the crystal, without the colour zoning a mined fancy pink is known for. The stone chosen first, the setting chosen for the stone — the same principle the maison has held since 1979.

specs.label: Gem Stone
specs.body: 4.98 carats · Fancy Very Pink oval · lab-grown · 13.54 × 9.14 × 5.78 mm.

specs.label: Metal
specs.body: Available in 18K white gold, yellow gold, or rose gold. Also in platinum.

specs.label: Setting
specs.body: Set to bring the length of the stone forward. Detail available on inquiry.

specs.label: More Details
specs.body: Lab-grown fancy colour, chosen for uniform colour distribution through the crystal. Provenance certificate available on request. Designed and made in Los Angeles.
